preregistration.decision_rule: Beneficial sequence-level effect at T=10 or T=20 requires sign consistency >=4/5 seeds and |Cohen's dz| >= 0.8 (conventional large band); net candidate->commit rescue (rescue>regression); no large operation-level regression. Transition-only effect => partial (B).
preregistration.note: Intervention on the full 212-dim gate vector only; recursive rollout; no readout/label information enters the intervention. gamma values fixed before results.
